name: Niagara Bottling - Kansas City MO (149th St)

fieldNotes.buildingId: Address 4000 E 149th St geocoded ROOFTOP to a road intersection inside the Three Trails / EastLink logistics park. The NE building in the cluster carries Walmart branding (confirmed via Street View) and is NOT Niagara. The audited building is the SW structure (~38.8529,-94.5537): a large warehouse/manufacturing building with a complex roofline, two rooftop solar arrays and visible process/utility roof equipment - the bottling-plant signature. No Niagara signage was readable in available Street View panos, so building identification is medium-confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at any driveway from the public road. Driveways are open. Classed false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide internal perimeter road and large dock aprons provide deep stacking room - 3+ truck queue capacity.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~50-60 dock doors across the N and W building faces from z19 imagery; estimate band 50+. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on separate building faces (N face and W face) suggest separate ship/receive flows; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: A dedicated marked trailer-parking lot with ~70-stall capacity sits along the W side beyond the dock apron, holding ~28 trailers in the imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unguarded driveway aprons leave ample paved width to add an express lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Kansas City MO metro fabric (south KC), surrounded by an active multi-building logistics park - Urban.
